About

An engineer shaped by both rigor and making.

I like problems that cross boundaries: theory and implementation, hardware and learning, technical depth and human need.

How I work

Model clearly. Measure honestly. Build for the constraint.

I start by understanding the system: what is observable, what is uncertain, what the physics already tells us, and what the deployment can actually support. Learning is most useful when it complements that structure.

Systems thinking

Connect decisions across the signal chain instead of optimizing isolated blocks.

Evidence first

Use measured behavior, reproducible simulation, and appropriate baselines.

Hardware awareness

Treat memory, power, latency, safety, and interfaces as design inputs.

Human context

Communicate the why, build with teams, and keep the user visible.

Product leadership

Product Design Club · CFI

As a leader in IIT Madras’s Centre for Innovation, I worked with 50+ makers across nine interdisciplinary projects. The role involved mentoring teams, structuring project reviews, facilitating collaborations, and helping ideas move from a problem statement to a prototype. The portfolio included work associated with two patent efforts and institute-wide design challenges reaching 300+ students.
